title: SF5143 (2025-2026 Regular): Toxic ammunition sale and possession prohibition

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2026-04-14; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2026/0/SF/5143/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced text as filed 2026-04-14; no votes recorded. Judged single: every part regulates ammunition, though the stated aim is lead toxicity (a reviewer may see an environment topic). Range grants and hunter education sections serve the same rule.

operative_text:
Section 4 (Minn. Stat. 325F.016): (a) Beginning August 1, 2027, no manufacturer or wholesaler may sell or offer for sale lead ammunition in this state.
Section 4 (Minn. Stat. 325F.016): (b) Beginning August 1, 2028, no retailer may sell or offer for sale lead ammunition in this state.
Section 5 (Minn. Stat. 624.7193, subd. 1): Beginning August 1, 2028, a person must not use or possess lead ammunition.
Section 5 (Minn. Stat. 624.7193, subd. 2): A person who violates this section is subject to the following civil penalties:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 87A.02, subd. 2): (b) The shooting range performance standards under this chapter include a prohibition on possessing and using lead ammunition.
